name: psk_mod_bpsk_sps8
description: psk_mod: differential BPSK, 8 samples per symbol, RRC 0.5

float_vs_gnuradio.rationale: GNU Radio shapes with pfb_arb_resampler_ccf; at an integer samples per symbol dividing 32 its arms hit the same taps as an interpolating FIR (every 32/sps-th prototype tap), so only float32 summation order differs: about 33 terms of values below 1.2 (ulp 1.2e-7), measured 1e-6.
